reads: Counts words and word pairs (TF-IDF, 20,000 features) and gives each one a weight
trained: 8,000 essays per arm (4,000 human + 4,000 AI). 5 random seeds
why: Simple and fast, and it shows which words push the score up

reads: Reads the whole sentence in context. All 125 million parameters are updated
trained: The same 8,000 essays. 2 passes, up to 512 words each. 5 seeds
why: The standard deep-learning text classifier: shows what context adds

reads: A 27-billion-parameter model that has read huge amounts of text. We keep it frozen
trained: Only a small add-on is trained (LoRA): 125 million numbers, 0.48% of the model. The same 8,000 essays, 1 pass, 2 seeds
why: LoRA is what makes a 27B model trainable on two 46 GB GPUs
cost: About 4 hours on two GPUs (2.9 h training + 74 min scoring)
